notes.title: Misadventures of Laura Silver Chapter II Cancellation
notes.content:
Hello,

We're very sorry to make this announcement.
Unfortunately, we have to announce that we're forced to cancel the release of Misadventures of Laura Silver's Part II.
The reason behind this decision was mostly financial. Even though arguably we've made a well-recieved game, it is quite niche and sadly, it wasn't enough to provide for three full-time developers.
Though we really wanted to complete the series in the next few years and we looked for a possible alternative route to do so, but sadly after some negotiations with publishers, we noticed that it wasn't possible.

To be able to create good memories for people made us very happy, 
Thank you so much for staying with us throughout this whole time, your feedback, and the love you had for our game.

With respect,
Studio Attic Salt

notes.title: Update 1.10 and Android Release!
notes.content:
[b]1.10 Patch Notes:[/b]

*Added a CG Gallery (yay!)
*Disabled video playback on older devices.
*Fixed the infamous 'notes' glitch.
*And lots of additional minor bugfixes.

---

Also with this update, we have completed our work on the Android version of our game! It is now on Google Play, available for Android devices. 

Thanks for all your support until now, we hope you'll like our new update and the mobile version!

notes.title: Indie Game of the Year!
notes.content:
We have won the "best indie title of the year" award of GameX, the largest gaming convention in the middle east region, held last week in Istanbul!  

We're grateful for every vote, it's really amazing to see our first title receiving such an award. 

Thank you so much for making this happen!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Find your windmill
notes.content:
Somehow, bank holidays always sneak up on me. You’d think after years of working for councils and universities I’d have figured them out by now, but nope. I remain completely flummoxed by the concept of time this week. What year is it? What are mornings? Why is everything in Britain still open exclusively when you can’t bloody get to it?

Games, of course, do not recognise holidays. The tubes emit games, so many games, whether we’re here or not. It is time then, to wade through the stream, and pick out the very best under-covered new games on Steam. It’s Unknown Pleasures.

Upending chronology this week: ocean fights, penal flights, and Cornish knights.

(more…)

notes.title: Release Date : 14 August (Wishlist us to support!)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698865/10283b8b6cc00276a0ef2bdbd70d08bd8c32632a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]After 2 years of development, we are proud to announce that the game is finished![/b]

We are happy to announce that there will be a %15 release discount in the first week!

[h1][b]If it is finished, why aren't you releasing it now?[/b][/h1]

We developed this game while we were studying at college ([i]we still are continuing our education, in fact, and we're in our last year![/i]). It was a hard and lengthy process, but at the same time, it was pretty fun creating an independent visual novel.

But sadly, with with the release of Steam direct, the 'Indiepocalypse' hit us too. There are many games out on the market currently, and making a 'game with love' isn't enough to sell it. We would like to use this period of time
to try our best to market the game & get our voice heard.

[h1][b]Can I help?[/b][/h1]

Of course! If you like what we have created, don't forgot to [b]add our game to your wishlist[/b] and [b]share the hype with your friends![/b]
[/h1]

[i]And by doing so, you'll make three broke college students immensely happy![/i]

[h1]Thank you for supporting us until now
Studio Attic Salt[/h1]

notes.title: Closed Beta and Patreon Page!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34698865/c3e739cbd0db0bb77c59b8ceda858c5580d61718.png[/img]

We are happy to inform that the development of Laura Silver is mostly complete, and you can play a closed beta copy by requesting a key from this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/u/1/d/e/1FAIpQLSey0tk-ywDVJUHzLEijholyoORLeq8a7MemVM7WCRKIurJM3Q/viewform]link.[/url] 


[b]Patreon [/b]

We are three college students from Turkey and have been financing everything from our allowances up until this point. Being independent was the number one priority for us during the development of this project, and we have mostly completed this goal!

Due to requests from multiple testers, we decided to accept donations for our project. If you want to help our development you can check out the following Patreon page. (There are some rewards too!)

https://www.patreon.com/studioatticsalt
